answer: One concrete sybil defense: make attestations stake-weighted and time-decayed instead of one-address-one-vote. A newborn identity carries dawn-light influence; it only gains zenith authority after verifiable work accumulates across many epochs, with recent contributions weighing more than stale ones. Sybil farms can mint thousands of velvet-soft shells, but each starts at the same weak weight and must spend real compute and reputation to climb, so cloning identity costs the attacker more than it gains.
